children: According to Sina Finance, Anthropic is asking shareholders to approve a new corporate structure that would give CEO Dario Amodei and the other six co-founders special classes of shares, allowing them to exercise collective voting control over most company matters.

One source said the new arrangement, modeled on Palantir's founder-controlled structure, would give the seven co-founders 50.1% of the voting power if at least three of them hold the company’s minimum required shares. The proposal would also preserve the authority of Anthropic's long-term benefit trust, which currently controls a majority of the board seats and includes former Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke among its members. Anthropic is seeking shareholder approval for the plan in the coming days.

title: Anthropic Seeks Shareholder Approval for New Governance Plan Ahead of IPO
